## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Slim and oral Semaglutide for weight loss.

### \#\#\#\#\#\# How does Semaglutide work for weight loss?

Semaglutide is a GLP-1 receptor agonist that mimics the incretin hormones your body produces after eating. It signals to your brain that you are full, reduces appetite, and slows gastric emptying. This leads to reduced caloric intake and clinically significant weight loss over time.

### \#\#\#\#\#\# What are the common side effects of Semaglutide?

The most common side effects include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and constipation, particularly during the initial titration period. Slim includes Vitamin B6 to help reduce nausea. Most side effects are mild and decrease as your body adjusts to the medication.

### \#\#\#\#\#\# Why does Slim include Vitamin B6?

Vitamin B6 is included to help alleviate the nausea commonly associated with GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy. It also supports metabolic function, amino acid metabolism, and neurotransmitter synthesis — contributing to overall wellness during your weight loss journey.

### \#\#\#\#\#\# What is an orally dissolvable tablet (ODT)?

An orally dissolvable tablet is a mint-flavored tablet that dissolves on your tongue without the need for water. Slim delivers Semaglutide through this convenient format — no injections required. Simply place the tablet on your tongue and let it dissolve.
